senses.gloss: During the night following the current day; during the evening of today.
to reserve
The favoring of relatives (most strictly) or also personal friends (more broadly) because of their relationship rather than because of their abilities.
(figuratively) Of or displaying the (supposed) ideals or standards of morality of that period; conservative; also, old-fashioned, out-of-date.
Of an object, outdated or no longer in vogue.
old-fashioned, out of date
Up to a time, as in the preceding time.
The sister or sister-in-law of one’s parent.
The formal academic study of folklore.
To have hailstones fall from the sky.
Being everywhere at once: omnipresent.
(figuratively) The side which is not normally seen, normally a dark, immoral place.
(Internet) A web page that is subordinate to another.
Risqué; obscene; profane; pornographic.
Any measure of central tendency, especially any mean, the median, or the mode.
Something that one does not know the name of.
A requirement for something; something needed.
A need; requirement, necessity. [from 16th c.]
The quality or state of being necessary, unavoidable, or absolutely requisite.
A sea or lake voyage, especially one taken for pleasure.

An agreement which the law will enforce in some way. A legally binding contract must contain at least one promise, i.e., a commitment or offer, by an offeror to and accepted by an offeree to do something in the future. A contract is thus executory rather than executed.
A legally binding contract enforceable in a court of law.
A formal binding agreement concluded by subjects of international law, namely, states and international organizations; a convention, a pact.
(transitive, algebra) To rewrite (an expression) as a longer, yet equivalent, sum of terms.
To express (an action, thought or idea) by means of particular words.
(transitive) To pronounce; to declare by judicial sentence.
(transitive) To tell in a descriptive way.
To explain or tell the meaning of; to translate orally into intelligible or familiar language or terms. applied especially to language, but also to dreams, signs, conduct, mysteries, etc.
To tell; narrate; to relate in detail.
(transitive) To narrate; to relate; to tell; to recount.
To relate (a story or series of events) in speech or writing.
An amount obtained by the addition of smaller amounts.
To make a reply or response to.
Not known; unidentified; not well known.
Supportive of, run by (a member of), pertaining to, or dominated by a political party represented by the colour blue.
A supporter of democracy; an advocate of democratic politics (originally (historical) as opposed to the aristocrats in Revolutionary France).
The space, often unfinished and with sloped walls, directly below the roof in the uppermost part of a house or other building, generally used for storage or habitation.
An attic or semi-finished room just beneath the roof of a house.
Of or pertaining to numbers.
Thin slices of the above in long strips.
The husband of one's child.
A man in the context of his own wedding; one who is going to marry or has just been married.
causing images to appear to move
The language of Uzbekistan.
A contributor to a blog (from weblog) or online journal.
To sadden or displease (someone) by underperforming, or by not delivering something promised or hoped for.
Quick and light in movement or action.
Agile; flexible; able to move fluidly and gracefully.
terrifying dangerous creature
non-human animal
(archaic) An animal seen as being without human reason; a senseless beast. [from 17th c.]
(poker) An unpaired card which is part of a pair, two pair, or three of a kind poker hand.
Any make-believe threat, especially one used to intimidate or distract; a real threat greatly exaggerated for those purposes.
The state of being imprisoned or detained, usually pending a trial.
Close observation of an individual or group; person or persons under suspicion.
A slightly curved but almost flat dish from which food is served or eaten.
A vessel such as a plate for holding or serving food, often flat with a depressed region in the middle.
An object round and gently curved, shaped like a saucer.
The quantity contained on a plate.
A portion of land or territory as defined by its landform, its geographical (and architectural) features.
View, natural features, landscape.
An open seating arrangement where project teams can communicate openly with minimal effort.
(sometimes, attributive) A region including much of this river; specifically, the region of the Amazon Rainforest, or of the Amazon River Basin.
A perennial herb of the genus Onobrychis with pale pink flowers, especially Onobrychis viciifolia (syn. Onobrychis sativa).
A coastal water body where ocean tides and river water merge, resulting in a brackish water zone.
The cardinal number immediately following seventy-four and preceding seventy-six.
A small, flat, baked good which is either hard and crisp or else soft but firm; a cookie.
A bird, usually black, of the genus Corvus, having a strong conical beak, with projecting bristles; it has a harsh, croaking call.
(constellation) A constellation of the southern sky south of the constellation Virgo, said to resemble a crow.
The fruit of this plant.
A class that may not be instantiated more than once, i.e. that implements the singleton design pattern.
The extent to which a resource is used for the intended purpose.
The state of being productive, fertile, or efficient.
The condition, or the degree, of being fertile.
(astronomy) Any sudden brightening of a previously inconspicuous star.
A person or entity engaged in the creation or improvement of certain classes of products.
The sense used to perceive sound.
(musical instruments) A sound hole, shaped like a lowercase f, through the top surface of a string instrument.
The grass Secale cereale from which the grain is obtained.
That which affects one’s welfare or happiness. A matter of interest to someone.
A state of discomfort arising from bashfulness or consciousness of having violated a social rule; humiliation.
The state of being dazed
The feeling or experience of being astonished; great surprise.
The state of being bewildered.
The state or quality of being perplexed.
The state of being clueless.
(archaic) A patent medicine, so named because salesmen would pray the Lord's Prayer over it before selling it.
(Greek god) The god of love and sexual desire; son of either Erebus and Nyx or Aphrodite and Ares. His Roman counterpart is Cupid.
The money available to be won in a hand of poker or a round of other games of chance; (figuratively) any sum of money being used as an enticement.
A small shop, especially one that sells fashionable clothes, jewelry and the like.
(countable) A shop selling women's hats.
master of a household
A marker pen used to highlight text.
(archaic, transitive) To lead, or guide; to escort.
To guide people to their seats.
To handle with skill and ease, especially a weapon or tool.
(obsolete) To manage; to conduct; to treat.
(transitive) To move or swing a weapon back and forth, particularly if demonstrating anger, threat or skill.
(obsolete, intransitive) To swell up (of water, waves etc.); to overflow, to surge (of bodily fluids). [14th–19th c.]
A record or narrative description of past events.
A round, traditionally wooden container of lesser capacity than a barrel, often used to store beer.
A slate or enamel board for writing on with chalk; a predecessor to a whiteboard.

A residential area located on the outskirts of a city or large town that usually includes businesses that cater to its residents; such as schools, grocery stores, shopping centers, restaurants, convenience stores, etc.
An area containing a collection of shacks, shanties or makeshift dwellings.
The sticky part of a flower that receives pollen during pollination.
A natural elevation appearing as if thrown up artificially; a regular and isolated hill, hillock, or knoll.
A small hill.
(geomorphology) A conical mound of earth with an ice core caused by permafrost uplift, particularly if lasting more than a year. [from 1920s]
(city and raion) A city, a municipal and regional administrative centre, an as well as, a raion of Donetsk Oblast in the Donbas region, in eastern Ukraine, on the Kalmius river.
The action of vindicating; also, the state of being vindicated.
Vindictive or wanting vengeance.

A city in Iran, the seat of Tabriz County's Central District and the capital of East Azerbaijan Province. Fourth largest city of Iran with population of about 1,600,000. Historical names: Davrezh, Tavrezh, Tavrez, Tauris.
The soft foot of a mammal or other animal, generally a quadruped, that has claws or nails; comparable to a human hand or foot.
(informal, especially, in plural) A hand.
A nucleoside derived from adenine and ribose, found in striated muscle tissue.
Any harsh noise, or confused mingling of sounds.
An apparatus for measuring altitude.
surgical removal of all or part of a limb, etc.
A lethal birth defect involving the abscence of a major portion of the brain and parts of the skull are missing; absence of the encephalon.
Fearlessness, intrepidity or daring, especially with confident disregard for personal safety, conventional thought, or other restrictions.
Of, pertaining to, or composed of baryons.
The state of being dilapidated, reduced to decay, partially ruined.
A contributor to a blog (from weblog) or online journal.
The part of a horse's leg between the fetlock joint and the hoof.

(of an approach to problem solving, learning, or discovery) That employs a practical method not guaranteed to be optimal or perfect; either not following or derived from any theory, or based on an advisedly oversimplified one. [from 1821]
(farriery) A stick with a hole in one end through which passes a loop, which can be drawn tightly over the upper lip or an ear of a horse and twisted to keep the animal quiet during minor surgery.
(archaic) That which is exposed to risk; that which is plighted or pledged; security; a gage; a pledge.
Something serving as a security for such an undertaking.
A prehistoric megalithic tomb consisting of a capstone supported by two or more upright stones, most having originally been covered with earth or smaller stones to form a barrow.
Having the qualities of a scatterbrain: absent-minded, forgetful, easily distracted.
An incident, action, or time period standing out by itself, but more or less connected with a complete series of events.
A plant of the genus Capparis.
A breakfast and snack food consisting of loose, crispy pellets made of nuts, rolled oats, honey and other natural ingredients.
Mischievous; tending to misbehave or act badly (especially of a child).
Causing mischief; injurious.
A tuft, or other natural ornament, growing on an animal's head, for example the comb of a cockerel, the swelling on the head of a snake, the lengthened feathers of the crown or nape of bird, etc.
A crest:
A wrinkled fold of skin, sometimes brightly coloured, hanging from the neck of birds (such as chicken and turkey) and some lizards.
The flap of erectile red skin on the beak of a male turkey.
The fleshy red pate of a rooster.
(zoology) A wattle or flap-like structure on the face.
(Greek mythology) King of Lapiths, who was punished by Zeus for trying to seduce Hera by being bound to a winged fiery wheel that was always spinning.
Behavior exhibiting excessive or uncontrollable emotions, in a wide range from joy to panic but usually including anxiety or fear.

(nuclear physics) Any of two or more forms of an element where the atoms have the same number of protons, but a different number of neutrons within their nuclei. Thus, isotopes have the same atomic number but a different mass number.
Ishikawa prefecture, a prefecture in Northern central region of Japan.
A person from Jamaica or of Jamaican descent.
Any arthropod of the subphylum Crustacea, including lobsters, crabs, shrimp, barnacles and woodlice.
The official language of Greenland, an Eskimo-Aleut language written with the Latin alphabet.
To build or alter according to personal preferences or specifications.
To adapt something to the needs or tastes of an individual.
The cry of a horse.
A stifled or broken laugh.
A gentle neighing.
A device or algorithm used to encode something.
A lack of moisture.
Cowper's fluid; pre-ejaculate.
A microcomputer on a single chip, used to control some device such as an automobile engine or a toy.
An island chain consisting of twelve main islands including Rhodes, its capital.
To handle someone or something in a rough way.
The region between the genitalia and anus.
A rock carving, especially one made in prehistoric times.
Having more than the usual number of complete sets of chromosomes in a single cell.
One who is persistently cheerful and optimistic, even when given cause not to be so.
A former duchy, historical province of Prussia, and now a geographic region of Central Europe split between Germany and Poland on the southern shore of the Baltic Sea.
The study of fruit in general and of the cultivation of fruit.
A transliteration of the Ukrainian surname Порошенко (Porošenko).

The unit structure of carbohydrates, of general formula CₙH₂ₙOₙ. Either the simple sugars or polymers such as starch and cellulose. The saccharides exist in either a ring or short chain conformation, and typically contain five or six carbon atoms.
The act of sedating, especially by use of sedatives.
Vibration.
A city in Balkan, Turkmenistan

A covered entrance to a building, whether taken from the interior, and forming a sort of vestibule within the main wall, or projecting without and with a separate roof. A porch often has chair(s), table(s) and swings.
A gallery, platform, or balcony, usually roofed and often partly enclosed, extending along the outside of a building.
The ordinal form of the number seventy.
A province in southwestern China, bordering Myanmar (Burma), Laos and Vietnam. Capital: Kunming.
(uncountable) The act or process of inferring by deduction or induction.
Sagacious in adapting means to ends; circumspect in action, or in determining any line of conduct.
A wide, brown variety of edible mushroom, Lentinula edodes.
